nodes.description: Constant total supply cap value (120000000 * 10**18) used to initialize the ERC20 cap.
bytes32 role identifier keccak256("MINTER") used for minting permission checks.
bytes32 role identifier keccak256("BLACKLIST") used to block accounts.
Public mapping address => uint256 holding per-minter mint allowances; written by _approveMinter.
Private mapping of account balances, mutated in _transfer/_mint/_burn.
Private nested mapping owner/spender allowance, mutated in _approve/transferFrom/burnFrom.
Private total token supply, mutated in _mint and _burn.
Mapping bytes32 role => RoleData (member set + admin role) controlling authorization.
Private supply cap consulted in _beforeTokenTransfer when minting.
Initializer setting admin role, role admins, ERC20 metadata and the capped supply; guarded by initializer modifier.
Admin-gated function granting MINTER_ROLE and setting a mint allowance.
Admin-gated function revoking MINTER_ROLE and zeroing the mint allowance.
Admin-gated function granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to an account.
Self-call revoking DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE from msg.sender.
Admin-gated function granting BLACKLIST_ROLE to an account.
Admin-gated function revoking BLACKLIST_ROLE from an account.
Admin-gated allowance increase using SafeMath add over minterAllowances.
Admin-gated allowance decrease using SafeMath sub over minterAllowances.
Admin-gated burn of a blacklisted account's entire balance.
ERC20 transfer override gated by notBlacklisted(msg.sender).
ERC20 transferFrom override gated by notBlacklisted(sender).
Minter-gated minting that also decrements the caller's mint allowance.
Public burn of tokens from the caller.
Public burn using allowance: reduces allowance then burns from account.
Private helper writing minterAllowances[account]; rejects the zero address.
Access-control modifier requiring isAdmin(msg.sender).
Access-control modifier requiring isMinter(msg.sender).
Modifier rejecting blacklisted accounts.
Public role grant guarded by the role's admin role check on _msgSender().
Public role revoke guarded by the role's admin role check on _msgSender().
Public role self-revocation requiring account == _msgSender().
View helper returning whether an account belongs to a role set.
Unchecked internal role grant meant for initialization.
Internal mutation of the admin role of a given role.
Private addition of an account to a role member set.
Private removal of an account from a role member set.
Internal mint increasing total supply and account balance.
Internal burn decreasing account balance and total supply.
Internal balance transfer between two accounts.
Internal allowance assignment in _allowances.
Hook enforcing that minted amount does not push totalSupply above cap.
Library helper checking extcodesize to detect contracts.
Library helper sending ETH via a low-level call, transferring control to recipient.
Caller-controlled address used in every authorization check and in burn/renounce paths.
Low-level call forwarding value to an arbitrary recipient inside sendValue, enabling reentrancy.
Supply and balance increase performed in _mint.
Balance and supply decrease performed in _burn.
Paired balance writes in _transfer.
Write of minterAllowances in _approveMinter without admin re-check in the helper itself.
Mutation of the _roles member sets in _grantRole/_revokeRole.
Cap comparison with totalSupply().add(amount) in _beforeTokenTransfer.

edges.reason: onlyAdmin evaluates isAdmin on the caller-controlled msg.sender, so authorization depends on untrusted input.
onlyMinter evaluates isMinter on the caller-controlled msg.sender.
notBlacklisted checks the caller/sender against BLACKLIST_ROLE.
mint uses _msgSender() both for the minter check and for the allowance decrement.
burn burns from _msgSender(), so the caller controls which balance is destroyed.
burnFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance consumption.
grantRole authorizes with hasRole(adminRole, _msgSender()).
revokeRole authorizes with hasRole(adminRole, _msgSender()).
renounceRole requires account == _msgSender().
renounceAdmin revokes DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE from msg.sender without further checks.
The initialize parameter decides who initially holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
admin is passed to _setupRole for the initial privileged grant.
isTopLevelCall controls the initializer state transitions that gate re-initialization.
initialize grants the admin role through _setupRole.
initialize sets the MINTER and BLACKLIST role admins via _setRoleAdmin.
_setRoleAdmin writes the adminRole field of the _roles mapping.
The account parameter of grantMinter receives MINTER_ROLE.
The amount parameter of grantMinter sets the initial mint allowance.
grantMinter delegates the actual privileged grant to grantRole.
grantMinter writes the mint allowance through _approveMinter.
amount is stored into minterAllowances, the value later compared against minted amounts.
The account parameter of revokeMinter loses MINTER_ROLE.
revokeMinter delegates the role removal to revokeRole.
revokeMinter zeroes the mint allowance via _approveMinter.
The account parameter of grantAdmin gains DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
grantAdmin grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE through grantRole.
renounceAdmin revokes the admin role from the caller via revokeRole.
The account parameter of blacklist receives BLACKLIST_ROLE.
blacklist grants BLACKLIST_ROLE through grantRole.
The account parameter of unblacklist loses BLACKLIST_ROLE.
unblacklist revokes BLACKLIST_ROLE through revokeRole.
The minter parameter selects the allowance entry to increase.
addedValue feeds SafeMath add on the stored minter allowance.
increaseMinterAllowance stores the SafeMath-added allowance via _approveMinter.
The minter parameter selects the allowance entry to decrease.
subtractedValue feeds SafeMath sub on the stored minter allowance.
decreaseMinterAllowance stores the SafeMath-subtracted allowance via _approveMinter.
The account parameter of destroyFunds is the blacklisted target whose balance is burned.
destroyFunds burns the blacklisted account balance with _burn.
toBurnAmount captures balanceOf(account) before the burn call.
destroyFunds triggers the balance/supply mutation performed by _burn.
The recipient parameter is the destination of the ERC20 transfer.
The amount parameter is subjected to SafeMath sub on the sender balance.
transfer delegates balance updates to _transfer.
transfer is gated by the notBlacklisted modifier on the caller.
The sender parameter of transferFrom is both the blacklist check input and the debit account.
The recipient parameter is the credit account of transferFrom.
The amount parameter is subtracted from the spender allowance using SafeMath.
transferFrom delegates balance updates to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance via _approve.
transferFrom reads and decreases the _allowances entry with SafeMath sub.
The account parameter of mint receives the newly created tokens.
The amount parameter is both minted and subtracted from the minter allowance.
mint creates tokens through _mint.
mint decrements the caller allowance via _approveMinter after SafeMath sub.
mint triggers the supply and balance increase in _mint.
The amount parameter is subtracted from the caller balance and total supply.
burn delegates to _burn.
burn triggers the balance/supply mutation in _burn.
The account parameter of burnFrom is the burned account.
The amount parameter is subtracted from the spender allowance with SafeMath.
decreasedAllowance is the SafeMath result written back through _approve.
burnFrom writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
burnFrom burns the account balance via _burn.
burnFrom reads the current allowance from _allowances before subtracting.
burnFrom triggers the balance/supply mutation in _burn.
The account parameter is the key written into minterAllowances.
The amount parameter is the value stored in minterAllowances.
_approveMinter writes the minterAllowances mapping without re-validating the caller.
_approveMinter performs the privileged allowance write operation.
The role parameter selects which role's admin gate is enforced.
The account parameter is added to the role member set.
grantRole checks the caller with hasRole before granting.
grantRole performs the actual membership addition via _grantRole.
hasRole reads the _roles mapping to answer authorization queries.
_grantRole adds the account to the _roles member set.
_grantRole performs the privileged role membership mutation.
revokeRole checks the caller with hasRole before revoking.
revokeRole performs membership removal via _revokeRole.
renounceRole removes the caller's own membership via _revokeRole.
_revokeRole removes the account from the _roles member set.
_revokeRole performs the privileged role membership mutation.
_setupRole bypasses admin checks and calls _grantRole directly.
_mint increases the recipient balance with SafeMath add.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath add.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, where the cap is enforced.
_mint performs the supply and balance increase operation.
_burn decreases the account balance with SafeMath sub.
_burn decreases _totalSupply with SafeMath sub.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating state.
_transfer decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance with SafeMath.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_transfer performs the paired balance writes.
transfer leads to the balance writes executed inside _transfer.
transferFrom leads to the balance writes executed inside _transfer.
_beforeTokenTransfer reads the _cap and compares it with the SafeMath-added total supply.
_beforeTokenTransfer reads totalSupply() when minting to enforce the cap.
The hook performs the cap comparison operation for minted amounts.
_approve writes the owner/spender allowance entry in _allowances.
The recipient parameter is the target of the low-level value call.
The amount parameter is compared against the contract balance and forwarded.
sendValue performs a low-level call transferring control and value to an untrusted recipient.
The recipient's fallback can re-enter sendValue's caller before state is finalized.
success records the outcome of the low-level call inside sendValue.
Contract-existence checks via isContract are used by the call helpers around sendValue's pattern.

normalization_plan.reason: admin is only meaningful as the initialization argument consumed by initialize.
account is the grantMinter argument passed to grantRole.
amount is the grantMinter argument forwarded to _approveMinter.
account is the revokeMinter argument passed to revokeRole.
account is the grantAdmin argument passed to grantRole.
account is the blacklist argument passed to grantRole.
account is the unblacklist argument passed to revokeRole.
minter indexes minterAllowances inside increaseMinterAllowance.
addedValue is only used by the SafeMath add in increaseMinterAllowance.
minter indexes minterAllowances inside decreaseMinterAllowance.
subtractedValue is only used by the SafeMath sub in decreaseMinterAllowance.
account is the burn target inside destroyFunds.
recipient is forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
amount is forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
sender is the blacklist-checked sender forwarded to _transfer.
recipient is forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
amount is forwarded to _transfer and the allowance sub in transferFrom.
account is the mint target passed to _mint.
amount is minted and subtracted from the minter allowance in mint.
amount is the burn amount passed to _burn.
account is the burn target in burnFrom.
amount is subtracted from the allowance and burned in burnFrom.
account is the mapping key written by _approveMinter.
amount is the mapping value written by _approveMinter.
role determines the admin check inside grantRole.
account is added to the role member set inside grantRole.
recipient is the low-level call target inside sendValue.
amount is the forwarded value inside sendValue.
toBurnAmount exists only as the intermediate balance read in destroyFunds.
decreasedAllowance is the intermediate allowance computation in burnFrom.
isTopLevelCall only controls the initializer guard around initialize.
success only holds the low-level call result inside sendValue.
